name: B10-0450/2025 – § 67/1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU strategic objectives for the 20th meeting of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES), to be held in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, from 24 November to 5 December 2025
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘which in its gravest form should be recognised as ecocide’
part_context: Insists that transnational wildlife crime be recognised by all Parties as a form of serious, organised and predicate crime[[33]](#footnote-33), <del>which in its gravest form should be recognised as ecocide</del>; calls on all EU Member States to align their national legislation with the UNTOC definition of serious crime by ensuring that wildlife offences are treated as predicate offences appropriately punishable under their criminal codes;
